tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Où est-ce que Karim habite ?” The verb tile is the infinitive of an -er verb: you choose the form.

B hears the question and conjugates the verb for the subject tile: je travaille, tu travailles, il travaille, nous travaillons, ils travaillent. je becomes j' before a vowel or a silent h (j'habite, j'écoute).
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.
